definitions.explanation: Of outstanding importance, achievement, or ability.
The quality of being great or distinguished.

examples.japanese: {偉大|いだい}な{科学者|かがくしゃ}だ。
{偉大|いだい}な{業績|ぎょうせき}を{残|のこ}した。
{歴史|れきし}に{残|のこ}る{偉大|いだい}な{発明|はつめい}だ。
examples.english: It is a great invention that will go down in history.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{偉大|いだい}さを{感|かん}じた。
{自然|しぜん}の{偉大|いだい}さに{圧倒|あっとう}された。
examples.english: I was overwhelmed by the greatness of nature.

examples.japanese: この{作品|さくひん}を{見|み}ると、{芸術家|げいじゅつか}の{偉大|いだい}さがよく{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: Looking at this work, you can really appreciate the artist's greatness.

notes:
{偉大|いだい} describes outstanding greatness.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {偉大|いだい}な (great)
- Noun: {偉大|いだい}さ (greatness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偉大|いだい}な{人物|じんぶつ} (great person)
- {偉大|いだい}な{功績|こうせき}/{業績|ぎょうせき} (great achievement)
- {偉大|いだい}な{指導者|しどうしゃ} (great leader)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {偉|えら}い: great, admirable (conversational)
- {偉大|いだい}: great, magnificent (formal)
